sloka: ब्रह्मणा निर्मितं पूर्वमिन्द्रार्थममितौजसा ।दत्तं सुरपतेः पूर्वं त्रिलोकजयकाङ्क्षिणः ।। ६.१११.५ ।।
transliteration: brahmaṇā nirmitaṁ pūrvamindrārthamamitaujasā ।dattaṁ surapateḥ pūrvaṁ trilokajayakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ।। 6.111.5 ।।

translations.english: Earlier, this powerful arrow was created for Indra's sake by Brahma and was bestowed to Indra, the king of gods, who was desirous of conquering the three worlds.
translations.hindi: आकाश में विमान में बैठे हुए देवता, गन्धर्वे, महोरग, ऋषि- दानव, दैत्य, गरुड़ तथा अन्य आकाशचारी जीव
